newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenyin says unaffected by CSRC moves.
newsitem.headline: Shenyin says unaffected by CSRC moves.

text.p: Shenyin Wanguo (H.K.) Ltd said on Friday that allegations relating to moves by China's securities watchdog to regulate Chinese brokerage firms would not have a significant impact on its operations.

The company said it made the statement in response to press reports on inquiries made by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) into the trading practices of certain mainland brokerage firms, including its parent Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd.

"Allegations relating to possible changes in the management of Shenyin & Wanguo (the parent) and the measures alleged to have been taken by CSRC will not have any significant impact on the operations, management or financial position of the company," it said.
Ultimate parent Shenyin & Wanguo is the largest shareholder of Shenyin Wanguo Holdings (BVI) Ltd, which holds about 54 percent of Shenyin Wanguo (H.K.).

Brokers in Beijing have said at least four brokerages, including Shenyin & Wanguo, China's largest, would be suspended from trading over alleged irregularities, in a move to cool the overheated mainland stock markets.
